leadText:
Elise (Japanese: エリー Ellie) is a character of the day who appeared in Seeking Shelter From the Storm!. She is the granddaughter of , who passed away prior to the events of the episode.

Her grandmother Lacy lived all alone at a large mansion. After she passed away, Elise and the rest of her family had plans of tearing the mansion down since it was unoccupied. When she came to inspect the building, she was surprised to see that and were inside, along with an .

The group explained to Elise they had entered the mansion to wait out a storm, and met Espurr while they were there. Espurr had known Lacy, having received food from her and played with her while she was still alive. Espurr had no idea Lacy had passed away, so when it returned one day, it couldn't find her anywhere. Espurr decided to stay in the mansion to await Lacy's return, and wound up waiting there for years. 

When Elise met Espurr, she was moved by its story and decided not to tear the mansion down, but renovate it instead. She also asked Espurr if it wanted to come along to visit Lacy's grave; it happily agreed.
